question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing benchwarmer, Claire is playing left winger, Dave is playing right back, and Eve is playing fullback.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Eve trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Finally, Alice and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) benchwarmer
(C) left winger
(D) right back
(E) fullback
solution:
Each row lists positions in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: left midfielder | benchwarmer | left winger | right back | fullback
1. Claire ↔ Bob: left midfielder | left winger | benchwarmer | right back | fullback
2. Claire ↔ Eve: left midfielder | left winger | fullback | right back | benchwarmer
3. Dave ↔ Alice: right back | left winger | fullback | left midfielder | benchwarmer
4. Alice ↔ Bob: left winger | right back | fullback | left midfielder | benchwarmer
5. Alice ↔ Bob: right back | left winger | fullback | left midfielder | benchwarmer
Bob is playing left winger, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
